1.title: Full Guest List for Trump’s State Dinner With Xi
1.summary: Tech titans including Jeff Bezos, Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Sam Altman and Tim Cook were among those invited to the event, hosted by President Trump and Melania Trump.

2.title: ‘America’s Bishop’ Was Beatified. 50,000 Catholics Showed Up.
2.summary: Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen, who was the country’s most visible Roman Catholic clergyman of the 20th century, is one step closer to sainthood after a ceremony in St. Louis.

3.title: In Trump’s White House, China’s Dictator Is Welcome. American Media, Less So.
3.summary: The showdown over President Trump’s partial media ban played out as he welcomed President Xi Jinping, whose government is ranked among the most repressive in the world.

4.title: U.N. Updates: Netanyahu Lashes Out at Critics and Underscores Threats to Israel
4.summary: In a combative speech, the prime minister defended Israeli military action across the Middle East, and attacked Mayor Zohran Mamdani of New York. Dozens of delegates walked out of the hall as he took the podium.

5.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
5.summary: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

6.title: Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit
6.summary: The highpoint of his time in Paris will be a giant Mass attended by more than half a million people.
